rationale: TTD is trading at 99.3% of its intraday range, essentially at the session high of $15.74 after a massive gap-up and sustained rally on strong earnings news — the momentum is exhausted with the last candle showing a slight fade from the high. Entering long here means chasing at the top of a 14%+ move with minimal reward-to-risk, while a short against a strong fundamental catalyst and upward momentum in a high-relative-volume session carries significant squeeze risk. With the broader market weak (SPY -0.79%, VIXY +2.42%) providing some short pressure but the stock ignoring it entirely, the asymmetry is poor in both directions and the prudent action is to stand aside.
